method: 19 axial sections per nozzle, 48 angular directions (both polygon vertices and facet mid-directions), then face-normal material probes from actual saved inner-surface intersections. Faces matching intended core within 0.008 mm are labeled fluid-facing; all measured distances come from saved STL triangles.

analytic_sidewall_bounds.scope: Unmodified source 24-sided neck and taper side facets. Does not bound the intentional mouth edge, arbitrary material chords, other cutters or export perturbation. Attachment overlap is bounded separately from the actual outer-positive surface distance at the attachment.

outer_positive_anchor_ball.scope: Source-positive containing ball minus maximum overlap-core radius, valid for s in [-attachment_overlap,0]. Final saved sidewall samples and mouth exclusions are reported separately.
